import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix case variant in species (adelie -> Adelie)
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'adelie': 'Adelie'})
    
    # Fix typo in island (Dram -> Dream)
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Dram': 'Dream'})
    
    # Convert text number columns to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix trailing space in sex
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2).to_dict()
    return result
